To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the battery configuration has an impact on the usable battery capacity and the position of the modules within the battery configuration has a significant impact.
the battery pack performance is affected by the battery configuration and the cell position within the battery.

battery configurations with parallel connection of modules and then assembled in serial are more robust against cell capacity variation, and the cell position within the battery has a significant impact of the usable capacity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a simulation tool to investigate the performance of a large-format battery pack in presence mismatch of the cell characteristics.
the optimization of the battery pack design and its performance in the presence of cell mismatch, and it is a contribution to the electrification of vehicles.
the investigation of the impact of battery configuration on the battery performance and the development of a simulation tool for battery pack design.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the configuration with modules connected in parallel and in series is the most robust one against variation of the cells’ characteristics.
, given the cells, the best battery configuration is the one with the highest number of cells directly connected in parallel.

a battery pack with modules directly connected to each other in parallel and assembled in series would be more robust against cell capacity mismatch than a battery pack with series connected modules and parallel connection of the modules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a battery configuration with modules connected in series and then in parallel, is more robust against variation in the cell capacity.
the series connection of modules in the battery pack should be avoided as far as possible and the parallel connection should be done at the lowest possible level.
, given the battery pack configuration, the cells should be placed in a way that the cells with lower capacity are located at the middle part of the pack.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the battery design should consider both the cell and the battery configuration in order to reach the best performance.
the cell position within a module and the position of the module itself within the battery pack can significantly affect the performance of the battery.
the battery design should take into account the cell variability and the impact of the battery configuration on the cell performance.
